findings.title: MIME type filter bypassed via Content-Type header spoofing
findings.recommendation: Add magic-byte validation using file-type library; force safe extensions from validated magic bytes

findings.title: All image upload/delete endpoints completely unauthenticated
findings.recommendation: Add JWT/session auth middleware globally to all /api/* routes

findings.title: N+1 ID generation with lexicographic overflow bug
findings.recommendation: Replace sequential IMG-NNNN IDs with UUID-based IDs

findings.title: Entity created but image upload failure leaves orphaned entity with no rollback
findings.recommendation: Add partial-success handling or decouple upload from entity creation flow

findings.title: Sequential ID string-sort collision under concurrency / overflow above 9999
findings.recommendation: Use uuidv4() for image IDs

findings.title: File extension preserved from client-controlled filename
findings.recommendation: Force stored extension from safe whitelist based on validated magic bytes

findings.title: Image delete does not verify entity ownership
findings.recommendation: Verify image.entity_id matches requested entity before deletion

findings.title: No aggregate upload size limit enables disk exhaustion
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware and per-entity image count limits

findings.title: Sequential IMG-ID generation unsafe under concurrency
findings.recommendation: Use UUID-based IDs

findings.title: Traceability enforcer excludes image-upload FRs (FR-070 to FR-089)
findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan all Plans/*/requirements.md

findings.title: Synchronous fs.existsSync/mkdirSync at module import blocks event loop
findings.recommendation: Switch to async fs methods; move dir creation to startup function

findings.title: Synchronous fs.unlinkSync in DELETE image handler
findings.recommendation: Switch to fs.promises.unlink

findings.title: Full entity existence check runs before multer receives file data
findings.recommendation: Defer entity check or run in parallel with upload

findings.title: No Cache-Control on static /uploads — every thumbnail re-validates
findings.recommendation: Add maxAge to express.static options

findings.title: Upload directory mkdirSync at module load crashes backend on permission error
findings.recommendation: Wrap in try/catch or move to startServer()

findings.title: Disk full — partial file written by multer not cleaned up on ENOSPC
findings.recommendation: Add ENOSPC error handling and cleanup of partial files in req.files

findings.title: DB record deleted before file — orphaned files on process kill
findings.recommendation: Reverse deletion order: file first, then DB record

findings.title: Stored filename displayed without length/character sanitization
findings.recommendation: Add server-side length limit and strip dangerous characters from original_name

findings.title: Sequential image IDs enable cross-entity enumeration
findings.recommendation: Use UUID-based IDs

findings.title: Uploads served without auth or Content-Security-Policy
findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; gate behind auth

findings.title: Orchestrator proxy buffers unlimited multipart body in memory
findings.recommendation: Add body size limit in multipart proxy branch

findings.title: FR-070 and FR-071 lack formal // Verifies: annotation
findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-070 and FR-071 annotations

findings.title: Shared image response types exported but never imported
findings.recommendation: Import ImageUploadResponse and ImageAttachmentListResponse in routes and client

findings.title: OTel spans missing on image upload/delete operations (FR-079)
findings.recommendation: Add withSpan() calls to image upload and delete route handlers

findings.title: SELECT * in deleteImage when only 3 columns needed
findings.recommendation: Select only required columns

findings.title: Redundant GET after upload discards response body
findings.recommendation: Use upload response data directly instead of re-fetching

findings.title: Serial image download for orchestrator submit
findings.recommendation: Use Promise.all for parallel image downloads

findings.title: No image compression — full 5MB served at 80px display height
findings.recommendation: Generate thumbnails server-side or use responsive image loading

findings.title: listImages query has no LIMIT — unbounded result set
findings.recommendation: Add LIMIT clause or paginate image queries

findings.title: Missing referenced files render as broken images with no fallback
findings.recommendation: Add onError handler with fallback image

findings.title: No timeout on image upload — frontend hangs indefinitely
findings.recommendation: Add AbortController with configurable timeout

findings.title: Image fetch failure silently swallowed in detail views
findings.recommendation: Show degraded-state indicator instead of silently showing 0 images

findings.title: Upload dir verified only at module load, not on each request
findings.recommendation: Verify directory in multer destination callback

findings.title: multer MIME-type-only validation — no magic-byte checking
findings.recommendation: Add file-type library for magic-byte validation

findings.title: multer 1 major version behind (1.4.5-lts.1 vs 2.1.1)
findings.recommendation: Plan upgrade alongside Express 5 migration

findings.title: Race condition in image ID generation (mitigated by SQLite serialization)
findings.recommendation: Replace with UUID-based IDs

findings.title: Upload metrics track count only — no bytes or duration histogram
findings.recommendation: Add bytes_total and duration_seconds histogram metrics

findings.title: Metrics label cardinality unbounded for static file paths
findings.recommendation: Normalize /uploads/* paths to a single label
